verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics platform, so a hardware-abstraction question is a fair one to ask of it, but the evidence never documents stable interfaces for swapping sensors or actuators without rewriting application code. Multi-vendor data normalization, agent adapters, and re-provisioning are adjacent features, not a hardware abstraction layer.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can swap sensors and actuators behind stable hardware-abstraction interfaces without rewriting application code
